marks.gloss_en: ותו: לא תעשה גרידא מנלן דדחי -- the rule's own source is demanded
the baraita's עליה derasha: the wife's sister is forbidden to the yavam even in the place of the mitzva -- the makor the stam's 3b.16 analysis is about
the word עליה is what does the work: it is needed to foreclose yibbum with the wife's sister
